```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import pandas as pd

print(
    '<div style="text-align: center; font-size: 30px; margin-bottom: 1.5em;">'
    'The <b>Latin American Left-Leaning Populism Index</b> (LALLPI) is a measure '
    'of active populist regimes in Latin America</div>'
)
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

# Pulled live from the published index every time this site is built --
# NOT hand-copied numbers. If this table ever looks out of sync with
# data/2025/output/index_2025.csv, that means the site needs rebuilding,
# not that the numbers need editing here.
df = pd.read_csv("data/2025/output/index_2025.csv")

FEATURED_YEAR = 2018  # matches the year discussed in the Documentation page narrative

year_data = df[(df["YEAR"] == FEATURED_YEAR) & (df["POP"].notna())].copy()
year_data = year_data.sort_values("POP", ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)

rows_html = []
for i, r in year_data.iterrows():
    rank = i + 1
    flag_url = f"https://flagcdn.com/w40/{r['ISO2'].lower()}.png"
    rows_html.append(f"""    <tr>
      <td><div class="country"><img class="flag" src="{flag_url}" alt="{r['COUNTRY']} flag">{r['COUNTRY']}</div></td>
      <td>{r['POP']:.1f} ({rank})</td>
      <td>{r['EP']:.1f}</td>
      <td>{r['IP']:.1f}</td>
      <td>{r['POP_R']:.2f}</td>
    </tr>""")

table_html = f"""<table class="lallpi-ranking">
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th>Country (2018)</th>
      <th>Overall populism</th>
      <th>Economic populism</th>
      <th>Institutional populism</th>
      <th>Populist rhetoric</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
{chr(10).join(rows_html)}
  </tbody>
</table>"""

print(table_html)
```
